en.title: Strange stories that touch music: "Fate/EXTRA" and "Tsukihime": TYPE-MOON's new work on TGS

The test machines for both games on site are PS5. For me, who has played "FGO" with a mobile phone before, facing a larger screen and holding a controller to command followers to explore and fight is a very novel experience. I made an appointment for the earliest trial time on the 17th, so there was almost no need to wait; and when I passed by the Aniplex booth in the afternoon, I found that it was already full of trial players. In the waiting queue, a player told me that although his favorite servant did not appear in the content he tried, he still felt very excited to experience the new game.

items.title: 触乐怪话：有趣的叠加
items.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 图/小罗 《小丑牌》最火的那阵子，我看了不少关于它的讨论。其中有种说法是，它在传统扑克游戏的基础上叠加了额外的玩法，让人感到既熟悉又陌生，这种奇妙的感觉是吸引人们注意到它的一个重要原因。在《小丑牌》后，另一些游戏也贯彻了这种思路，有玩麻将的，有做饭的，有推币的，都是在“简单步骤、常见内容”上叠加Rogue，玩下来倒也各有各的乐趣。 不过，Rogue好玩归好玩，久了终归会累。我也想找找这个大类的其他小分支来试试——比如，同样以简单玩法做基底，加点别的行不行？答案当然是可以。大数据也非常了解我，开始频繁推荐起《谋杀数独》（Murdoku）来。 顾
